name: Mabeopsonyeo-ui Jeonguineun Jugeotda
source: One day, after the death of her admired senior, the magical girl Hyena, who has lost her sense of justice, embarks on a journey with her familiar Nero to reclaim her lost ideals. Will the justice they encounter at the end of their journey be the truth?
